pivot_construction.connectedness: voltage exponents generate C13; since 13 is prime any nonzero voltage is a generator
pivot_construction.normalize: choose generator and pivot e0 so d(e0)=g-1

gauge_freedom.spanning_tree: arbitrary spanning tree of the 210-vertex quotient graph
gauge_freedom.pivot: any cotree edge with nonzero voltage after chosen section/tree
gauge_freedom.canonicality: the module isomorphism class is canonical; the displayed basis/intertwiner is choice-dependent

theorem: After choosing a quotient spanning tree and one nonzero-voltage pivot edge, the free C13 cover admits an explicit chain-level decomposition H1 = F2*(N e0) plus 315 free F2[C13] summands generated by e_j-q_j e0. This gives a constructive 4096-dimensional intertwiner blueprint to F2[V2], whose one fixed state and 315 free C13 orbits have the same standard module basis.
boundary: Exact group-algebra construction for the free C13 cover. A numeric 4096x4096 matrix requires choosing an actual spanning tree, lift section and ordering of V2 orbits; those choices are intentionally not called canonical.
